title: Twin Forge Dice
story: Two dice: X = the larger value, Y = the sum.
hints: List the cells of the 6×6 grid with max 4 and sum 6.
pattern: joint PMF from the grid; marginals by summing

title: The Joint Ledger
hints: Independent ⇔ every cell = product of its marginals.

title: The Tilted Square
story: (X, Y) has density f(x, y) = c(x + y) on the unit square.
hints: Integrate over the triangle below x + y = 1.

title: The Midnight Rendezvous
story: Two spies each arrive at a time uniform over a {T}-minute window, independently. Each waits {w} minutes, then leaves.
hints: Draw the T×T square of arrival times. Where is |X − Y| ≤ w?
solution: The two corner triangles have total area (T − w)² → 1 − ((T − w)/T)².

title: Two Sand-Timers
story: Two independent uniform(0,1) sand-timers X and Y.
hints: The density of the sum is a triangle; or use area in the unit square.

title: The Bowling Rivals
story: Asha scores N({m1}, {s1}²) and Bodhi scores N({m2}, {s2}²), independently.
hints: D = Bodhi − Asha is normal. What are its mean and variance?
pattern: sums/differences of independent normals are normal

title: Two Roads
story: Carts on the north road ~ Poisson({a}), on the south road ~ Poisson({b}), independent.

phases.ask: Given {k} carts in total, P(exactly 1 came by the north road)?

hints: The sum of independent Poissons is Poisson.
Conditional on the total → binomial split.
pattern: Poisson sum; conditional split is binomial

title: Split Harvest
story: X₁ ~ Bin({n1}, ½) and X₂ ~ Bin({n2}, ½) are independent. You learn X₁ + X₂ = {t}.
hints: With equal p, the p's cancel, leaving pure counting.
pattern: conditioning a sum of binomials → hypergeometric

title: Two Machines
story: Two mills fail at independent exponential times with rates {l1} and {l2} per hour.

phases.ask: P(no failure in the first {t} hours)?

hints: min of independent exponentials is exponential with summed rate.

title: Five Sparks
story: {n} sparks land at independent uniform(0,1) positions.
hints: E[k-th smallest of n uniforms] = k/(n+1).

title: Three Stones on a Line
story: Three stones X₁, X₂, X₃ fall at independent random points on a line segment.

phases.ask: P(X₃ lies between X₁ and X₂)?

hints: By symmetry, each stone is equally likely to be the middle one.

title: The Shifting Rate
story: f(x, y) = x·e^(−x(y+1)) for x, y > 0.
hints: f(y | x) = f(x, y)/f_X(x). Recognise the shape in y.
solution: Given X = x, Y ~ Exp(x) → e^(−xy).
pattern: conditional density: fix x, normalise in y
